note: Three frozen benchmark cases. allowed_paths is ENFORCED out-of-process by benchmarks/runner/: each trial runs in a real git-clone sandbox, and any change to a path NOT under allowed_paths makes benchmarks/runner/snapshot.diff non-empty, fails benchmarks/runner/integrity.verify, and EXCLUDES the trial from scoring (integrity_ok is withheld; see benchmarks/README.md, 'Trial integrity -- enforced by benchmarks/runner/'). immutable_paths is documentation of intent -- the runner enforces the complement (anything not under allowed_paths is a violation). case_fingerprint = first 64 hex of sha256(cat <prompt_file> <acceptance_check>) -- the two-file case definition (prompt + check ONLY). It is retained purely as scorecard.py's control/treatment pairing key: the scorer only checks that a paired control and treatment record carry the SAME value, it never recomputes it from disk. If a case is deliberately regoldened (its prompt or check edited), recompute the value by hand -- see benchmarks/README.md, 'Recomputing a case_fingerprint'. Every acceptance_check exits 1 against the starting sandbox file and exits 0 only after a trial completes the task. The runner resolves and runs every acceptance_check (and its check_<id>.sh) from a PRISTINE copy of benchmarks/cases/ outside the trial sandbox -- never the arm's copy -- see benchmarks/README.md and plugins/sefi-core/skills/run-sefi-benchmark/SKILL.md.
